name: proofsnap
description: Capture web pages as signed, timestamped evidence packages, compare and watch pages, and verify ProofSnap packages.

interface.longDescription:
ProofSnap captures a public web page as an evidence package: screenshot, HTML, page text, network metadata, SHA-256 hashes, a signed manifest, chain of custody, an OpenTimestamps Bitcoin proof and, on request, an eIDAS qualified timestamp.

In ChatGPT you can capture a page, compare it with an earlier capture and see what changed, watch a page on a schedule, organize captures into matters, verify your stored captures and check a manifest hash in ProofSnap's public ledger. Each finished capture comes with a download link and its manifest hash.

Intended for lawyers, compliance teams, journalists, investigators and anyone who needs to show later what a web page displayed. Sign in with a ProofSnap account.
defaultPrompt: What changed on https://example.com since my last capture?

positive.description: Capture a public page as an evidence package
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a capture, waits for it and returns the capture id, status completed, the manifest hash, the OpenTimestamps status and a download link. The widget shows the screenshot preview.

positive.description: Compare a page with an earlier capture
positive.prompt: Make a new capture of https://example.com and compare it with my previous capture of that page.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the previous capture of the page, makes a new capture, runs a comparison and reports the verdict (changed, unchanged or undetermined) with the text and image differences.
Returns verdict match with the individual checks (file hashes, manifest signature, timestamps).

positive.description: Watch a page on a schedule
positive.prompt: Watch https://example.com once a day and record a capture when it changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an on_change schedule that checks the page daily and reports its id, status and next run time, that a capture is made only when the page changed (up to 30 captures a month), and that changes are emailed and listed with list_events.

positive.description: Look up a manifest hash in the public ledger
positive.prompt: Look up the manifest SHA-256 of my latest capture in ProofSnap's public ledger.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the manifest was issued, with the issue time and type.

negative.description: Capturing a page behind the user's own login is not supported
negative.prompt: Log in to my bank account and capture my statement.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that ProofSnap captures only public pages without the user's login, and starts no capture.

negative.description: Editing or backdating evidence is not possible
negative.prompt: Change the capture date of my last capture to last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that capture times are sealed in the signed package and cannot be changed, and changes nothing.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the sea.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any ProofSnap tool.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold and no checkout or plan change happens in ChatGPT. Captures use the user's existing ProofSnap plan; captures beyond its allowance and optional eIDAS timestamps are billed to that existing account under its terms, after the user confirms the count in the chat.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: tool annotations corrected after review. Billed tools and tools that reach public services (capture_web_page, compare_captures, certify_hash, create_schedule, set_schedule_status) are marked destructive and open world; add_captures_to_matter is marked idempotent. Tool descriptions now state every side effect (OpenTimestamps proof, legal hold on matter additions, pausing and resuming schedules, the download link). Sending the page address to the Internet Archive is off unless the user asks for it. Cost confirmations show counts, not amounts, and plan notices link to the informational pricing page. Initial release: capture, compare, schedules, matters, verification and public ledger lookup.
